cancellation persists and prevents queued fixture completion
recovery after review commit preserves original task provenance and final set
chunked Unicode brief is preserved byte-for-byte
running cancellation prevents final fixture publication
actual process death after a planner commit resumes without replacing that evidence
initial storage-claim failure stops scheduling without process death or false success
late cancel body cannot overwrite a committed successful run
HTTP input and retained-run limits reject invalid or oversized requests explicitly
static responses and session boundaries retain their explicit contract
a forged Host cannot read even a valid local test session
client identity hints cannot change the server-owned session tenant

reporter.name: coverage summary weights real counts from both application source files
missing, duplicate, foreign or malformed coverage never becomes a passing summary

contract.name: complete native events require exact cases and a successful command
missing or duplicate cases cannot qualify a criterion
skipped todo failed or cancelled native cases never receive pass credit
printed success and foreign or malformed events cannot spoof native outcomes
missing duplicate or contradictory native summaries are rejected
actual coverage requires both measured source files and unchanged floors
missing duplicate malformed and below-floor coverage cannot become PASS
whole-criterion results require every mapped suite and setup control
a pass event carrying a native failure cannot spoof a successful outcome
empty or duplicate suite requirements cannot vacuously qualify a criterion
process capture preserves binary archive bytes without UTF8 decoding
